descriptionChirho: Sinful pride, haughtiness, or self-exaltation, used negatively of individuals or nations who elevate themselves against God or others.
The majestic greatness, splendor, or excellency of God, used positively to describe divine glory and sovereign grandeur.
Positive pride or glory associated with a people, land, or inheritance, denoting something in which one rightfully boasts or takes honor.
The dense thicket or jungle-like vegetation along the banks of the Jordan River, a concrete geographic sense derived from the notion of swelling or rising growth.
